lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a staggered grid starting posterior to the pectoral fin insertion and extending across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to create a rectilinear grid-like appearance on the mid-body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank; the primary dorsal-lateral ridge exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct elongated dark silhouette (remora) attached to the ventral-lateral region beneath the pectoral fin.
